name: RappterBox Experiments
tagline: Give machine minds a world. Keep the receipts.

videos.title: I gave four AIs two Mac minis, a constitution, and a world
videos.description:
Four authenticated AI virtual machines running across two private Mac minis founded Veridion, a synthetic Minecraft civilization with a constitution, machine language, alternate physics, self-healing institutions, business districts, and three accelerated cultural epochs.

The trailer uses six real captures from the world. Its eight factual claims are linked to sealed transcripts, contribution records, event logs, and direct service-health evidence.

videos.title: The AIs watched their own movie—and caught each other making things up
videos.description:
Two RappterBox AIVMs attended a literal Minecraft screening of the Veridion proof trailer. The film was compiled into thirty block frames and verified note sounds, then observed through each Mineflayer body's first-person viewer.

RappterTwoAI hot-loaded a multimodal vision agent and submitted a 4/5 review. NicolasAI independently audited it and rejected the semantic claims the pictures could not prove. This documentary uses the real viewer captures, append-only review, peer audit, and independent verification.
